Build a measurement card for auto$ctx$measurement

Source: R/claim_helpers.R
make_measurement_card.Rd

Constructs a named list suitable for assignment to auto$ctx$measurement. level is the main operative field. Gate 0B normalizes legacy aliases such as "composite" and "latent", infers "plausible_values" when ctx$plausible_values$pv_tasks is present, and derives conservative pipeline notes when missingness_plan or scoring_pipeline are omitted.

Usage

make_measurement_card(
  level,
  missingness_plan = NULL,
  reliability = NULL,
  invariance = NULL,
  scoring_pipeline = NULL
)

Arguments

level

(character(1)) Measurement level. One of "item", "scale", "factor_score", "plausible_values".

missingness_plan

(character(1) | NULL) How missing data are handled in the pipeline.

reliability

(list | character(1) | NULL) Reliability evidence (e.g. list(method = "Cronbach alpha", value = 0.87)).

invariance

(list | character(1) | NULL) Measurement invariance status across groups / time points.

scoring_pipeline

(character(1) | NULL) How the outcome and predictors are scored / encoded.

Value

A named list ready to assign to auto$ctx$measurement.

Examples

card = make_measurement_card(
  level = "item"
)
